# Prétraitements classiques

## Colonnes utiles

```{r}
#CréATION variable age simplifiée (age_CY : "adult" ou numéros = juveniles)
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_CY == "adult" ~ "adult",
      !is.na(age_CY) & age_CY != "adult" ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
table(DATA_ALL$age_group, useNA = "ifany") 


# ADD column "MIGRATION" spring / autumn
DATA_ALL$date <- as.Date(DATA_ALL$timestamp)
DATA_ALL$date <- as.Date(DATA_ALL$date)
#DATA_ALL$date

DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(
      month(date) %in% 1:7  ~ "spring",
      month(date) %in% 8:12 ~ "autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# data_sub5
#CréATION variable age simplifiée (age_CY : "adult" ou numéros = juveniles)
data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_CY == "adult" ~ "adult",
      !is.na(age_CY) & age_CY != "adult" ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
table(data_sub5$age_group, useNA = "ifany") 


# ADD column "MIGRATION" spring / autumn
data_sub5$date <- as.Date(data_sub5$timestamp)
data_sub5$date <- as.Date(data_sub5$date)
#data_sub5$date

data_sub5 <- data_sub5 %>%
  mutate(
    MIGRATION = case_when(

  )
```

## Délimitation de la zone

```{r}
# Création de la  zone_interet
ecoregions <- st_read(here( "Alice/Data_analysis/Ecoregions2017/Ecoregions2017.shp"), wkt_filter = st_as_text( st_as_sfc(st_bbox(c( xmin = -20, xmax = 60, ymin = 0, ymax = 40 ), crs = 4326)) ) ) 
names(ecoregions) 
#unique(ecoregions$BIOME_NAME)
#unique(ecoregions$ECO_NAME)

desert <- ecoregions[ecoregions$BIOME_NAME == "Deserts & Xeric Shrublands", ] 
plot(desert["BIOME_NAME"])

sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(sahara["BIOME_NAME"])

tibesti_sahara <- ecoregions[grepl("Sahara|Tibesti-Jebel Uweinat", ecoregions$ECO_NAME), ] 
plot(tibesti_sahara["BIOME_NAME"])

pts_sf <- st_as_sf(DATA_ALL, coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"), crs = 4326)

coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
# coords[,1] = longitude, coords[,2] = latitude
lat <- coords[,2]
intersects_vec <- apply(st_intersects(pts_sf, tibesti_sahara, sparse = FALSE), 1, any)

pts_sf$Zone_interet <- ifelse(
  (lat >= 17.51 & lat <= 26.0) | intersects_vec,
  "Zone_interet",
  NA
)
unique(pts_sf$Zone_interet)
# Check
tab <- table(pts_sf$Zone_interet, useNA = "ifany")
# proportion
prop <- tab / sum(tab) * 100
prop
# Add Zone_interet to data
DATA_ALL$Zone_interet <- pts_sf$Zone_interet
unique(DATA_ALL$Zone_interet)


# Jeu de donnée séparé

#Mise en facteur
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  mutate(across(c(
    Zone_interet, age_group, individual.local.identifier, MIGRATION
  ), as.factor))
table(DATA_ALL$Zone_interet)

# Séléction Zone_interet
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(!is.na(Zone_interet))
unique(DATA_ALL$Zone_interet)
```

## Alignement des coordonnées

```{r}
DATA_sf <- st_as_sf(DATA_ALL, coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"), crs = 4326)
DATA_proj <- st_transform(DATA_sf, crs = 3857)  # ou UTM adapté

# Aligner les coordonnées
coords <- st_coordinates(DATA_proj)

DATA_ALL$x <- coords[,1]
DATA_ALL$y <- coords[,2]

```

## Base comparable de trajectoire

```{r}
# Projection métrique et normalisation
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  group_by(bird_year) %>%
  arrange(timestamp) %>%
  mutate(
    dist_cum = cumsum(replace_na(ddist_2D, 0)),
    dist_norm = dist_cum / max(dist_cum)
  )
```

## Interpolations

```{r}

# Interpoler les trajectoires sur une grille commune
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 100)

interp_traj <- function(df) {
  data.frame(
    dist_norm = grid,
    x = approx(df$dist_norm, df$x, xout = grid, rule = 2)$y,
    y = approx(df$dist_norm, df$y, xout = grid, rule = 2)$y
  )
}

# Créer la liste de trajectoires par individu + saison
traj_list <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(!is.na(MIGRATION), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, MIGRATION, bird_year) %>%
  group_split()

# Interpoler toutes les trajectoires
traj_list_interp <- lapply(traj_list, interp_traj)

# Calculer la distance moyenne entre les migrations d'un même individu
traj_dist <- function(t1, t2) {
  mean(sqrt((t1$x - t2$x)^2 + (t1$y - t2$y)^2))
}

pairwise_dist <- function(trajs) {
  if(length(trajs) < 2) return(NA)
  combn(seq_along(trajs), 2, function(idx) {
    traj_dist(trajs[[idx[1]]], trajs[[idx[2]]])
  }) %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## Visualisation des anomalies

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| include: false
# Retrait de Charline
# Demi-tour au Nord de l'Algérie à : 2025-05-10 15:00
# Mais pause avant, vers 13h. Donc on coupe à 2025-05-10 13:00
# Départ migration automne 2025 2025-09-24 10:00
# => Donc estivage de 2025-05-10 13:00 à 2025 2025-09-24 10:00


# verif 1 : Charline
start_time <- as.POSIXct("2025-05-10 13:00:00", tz = "UTC")
end_time   <- as.POSIXct("2025-09-24 10:00:00", tz = "UTC")
data_verif <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(
    timestamp >= start_time &
    timestamp <= end_time
  )

ggplot(data_verif, aes(x = x, y = y, group = individual.local.identifier, color = age_group)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
    "adult" = "darkorchid2"   
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )


# verif 2 : Mina
data_verif2 <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(
    country == "Tunisia"
  )

ggplot(data_verif2, aes(x = x, y = y, group = individual.local.identifier, color = age_group)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
    "adult" = "darkorchid2"    
  )) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
# => C'est Mina de Rians en Tunisie spring 2023
```

## Découpe et jdd par saison et age_group

```{r}

# Découpe des anomalies DATA_ALL

# Charline
start_time <- as.POSIXct("2025-05-10 13:00:00", tz = "UTC")
end_time   <- as.POSIXct("2025-09-24 10:00:00", tz = "UTC")
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL[
  !(
    DATA_ALL$timestamp >= start_time &
    DATA_ALL$timestamp <= end_time &
    DATA_ALL$individual.local.identifier == "Charline de la Grisonnière"
  ),
]
# Mina
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL[
  !(
    DATA_ALL$country == "Tunisia" &
    DATA_ALL$individual.local.identifier == "Mina de Rians"
  ),
]

# Par saison
DATA_ALL_spring <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(MIGRATION == "spring")
DATA_ALL_autumn <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(MIGRATION == "autumn")

# Par age_group
#Juvenile
DATA_ALL_spring_juv <- DATA_ALL_spring %>%
  filter(age_group == "juvenile")
DATA_ALL_autumn_juv <- DATA_ALL_autumn %>%
  filter(age_group == "juvenile")
# Adult
DATA_ALL_spring_ad <- DATA_ALL_spring %>%
  filter(age_group == "adult")
DATA_ALL_autumn_ad <- DATA_ALL_autumn %>%
  filter(age_group == "adult")
```

## Identification des pauses

```{r}
# Placement des sites sans mouvement "sit"
# move_2 : Bird in flight or perched v2 (determined using ground speed thresholds plus assigning all HF positions > 50 m a.g.l. as in-flight): "move" or "sit"

# DATA_ALL
# Séquences de "sit" pour les vraies pauses
DATA_ALL <- DATA_ALL %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier) %>%
  mutate(
    is_sit = move_2 == "sit",
    sit_block = cumsum(is_sit != lag(is_sit, default = first(is_sit)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
# Calculer la durée de chaque bloc de sit
sit_summary <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(is_sit) %>%
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, sit_block, daynight_0) %>%
  summarise(
    duration_min = as.numeric(difftime(max(timestamp), min(timestamp), units = "mins")),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Grader que les blocs > 10min
valid_sit <- sit_summary %>%
  filter(duration_min >= 10)
# Récupérer les points corréspondants
DATA_sit_long_all <- DATA_ALL %>%
  inner_join(valid_sit,
             by = c("individual.local.identifier", "sit_block"))

#### Comptage
valid_sit %>%
  filter(daynight_0 == "day") %>%
  distinct(individual.local.identifier, sit_block) %>%
  count(individual.local.identifier)
```

# Trajectoires par saison

## Spring + autumn

```{r}
# Plot des pauses sur les trajectoires
ggplot(DATA_ALL,
       aes(x = x, y = y,
           group = interaction(individual.local.identifier, segment_id),
           color = age_group)) +
  
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = DATA_sit_long_all,
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "cornflowerblue",
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
    "adult" = "darkorchid2"
  )) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )



# Points de nuit : Inconvéniant, peut inclure un début ou une fin de vol, seulement en fonction de la position du soleil
ggplot(DATA_ALL,
       aes(x = x, y = y,
           group = interaction(individual.local.identifier, segment_id),
           color = age_group)) +
  
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = subset(DATA_ALL, daynight_0 == "night"),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
    "adult" = "darkorchid2"
  )) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())



### Superposition
ggplot(DATA_ALL, aes(x = x, y = y)) +

  # DENSITÉ
  stat_density_2d(
    aes(fill = after_stat(level)),
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.3,
    contour = TRUE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Densité") +
  
  # Trajectoires
  geom_path(
    aes(group = interaction(individual.local.identifier, segment_id),
        color = age_group),
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # SIT
  geom_point(
    data = DATA_sit_long_all,
    aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "stop"),
    color = "cornflowerblue",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # Nuit
  geom_point(
    data = subset(DATA_ALL, daynight_0 == "night"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "night"),
    color = "black",
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "juvenile" = "darkorange1",
      "adult" = "darkorchid2"
    ),
    name = "Age"
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("stop" = 18, "night" = 19),
    name = "Stops"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Spring

```{r}
# Points de nuit
ggplot(DATA_ALL_spring,
       aes(x = x, y = y,
           group = interaction(individual.local.identifier, segment_id),
           color = age_group)) +
  
  geom_path(alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = subset(DATA_ALL_spring, daynight_0 == "night"),
    aes(x = x, y = y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.2
  ) +
  
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "#E63973",
    "adult" = "#F77F00"
  )) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )




### Superposition
ggplot(DATA_ALL_spring, aes(x = x, y = y)) +

  # DENSITÉ
  stat_density_2d(
    aes(fill = after_stat(level)),
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.3,
    contour = TRUE
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Densité") +
  
  # Trajectoires
  geom_path(
    aes(group = interaction(individual.local.identifier, segment_id),
        color = age_group),
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  
  # SIT
  geom_point(
    data = DATA_sit_long_spring,
    aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "stop"),
    color = "cornflowerblue",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # Nuit
  geom_point(
    data = subset(DATA_ALL_spring, daynight_0 == "night"),
    aes(x = x, y = y, shape = "night"),
    color = "black",
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  coord_equal(expand = FALSE) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
    "juvenile" = "#E63973",
    "adult" = "#F77F00"
    ),
    name = "Age"
  ) +
  
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("stop" = 18, "night" = 19),
    name = "Stops"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )



##### Carte avec biome : Tout est converti en sf

# Tout convertir en sf propre
pts_sf <- st_as_sf(
  DATA_ALL_spring,
  coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"),
  crs = 4326
)
sit_sf <- st_as_sf(
  DATA_sit_long_spring,
  coords = c("location.long", "location.lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

# Age_group
pts_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age_CY == "adult" ~ "adult",
      !is.na(age_CY) & age_CY != "adult" ~ "juvenile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )


# Trajectoires en sf
lines_sf <- pts_sf %>%
  arrange(individual.local.identifier, timestamp) %>%   # adapter si besoin
  group_by(individual.local.identifier, segment_id) %>%
  summarise(do_union = FALSE) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")
str(lines_sf)


# DENSITÉ (remplacement de stat_density_2d)

# Grille : kernel density raster
library(MASS)
coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
k <- kde2d(coords[,1], coords[,2], n = 200)

# transformer en raster sf-compatible
library(terra)
r <- rast(k)
crs(r) <- st_crs(pts_sf)$wkt

# convertir en sf pour ggplot
dens_sf <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE)
names(dens_sf) <- c("x", "y", "density")



## Coupe et plot

tibesti_sahara_proj <- st_transform(tibesti_sahara_proj, 4326)

# Coupe
cut_line <- st_sfc(
  st_linestring(matrix(
    c(10, -90,
      10,  90),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  )),
  crs = 4326
)
cut_line <- st_buffer(cut_line, 0)
zone_west <- st_difference(
  tibesti_sahara_proj,
  st_sfc(
    st_polygon(list(matrix(
      c(10, -90,
        180, -90,
        180, 90,
        10, 90,
        10, -90),
      ncol = 2,
      byrow = TRUE
    ))),
    crs = 4326
  )
)
plot(st_geometry(zone_west)) # Vérif

# Plot
ggplot() +

  # zone tronquée
  geom_sf(
    data = zone_west,
    fill = NA,
    color = "azure2",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # densité
  geom_raster(
    data = dens_sf,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = density),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Densité") +

  # trajectoires
  geom_sf(
    data = lines_sf,
    aes(color = individual.local.identifier),
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # SIT
  geom_sf(
    data = sit_sf,
    shape = 18,
    color = "cornflowerblue",
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  # nuit
  geom_sf(
  data = pts_sf,
  aes(shape = daynight_0),
  color = "black",
  size = 1,
  alpha = 0.6
) +

  coord_sf() +
  
  
  # Légende stops
  scale_shape_manual(
  values = c("sit" = 18, "night" = 19),
  name = "Stops"
) +

  theme_minimal()



#### Avec toutes les régions
```

```{r}
  summarise(do_union = FALSE) %>%
  st_cast("LINESTRING")

# DENSITÉ (remplacement de stat_density_2d)

# Grille : kernel density raster
library(MASS)
coords <- st_coordinates(pts_sf)
k <- kde2d(coords[,1], coords[,2], n = 200)

# transformer en raster sf-compatible
library(terra)
r <- rast(k)
crs(r) <- st_crs(pts_sf)$wkt

# convertir en sf pour ggplot
dens_sf <- as.data.frame(r, xy = TRUE)
names(dens_sf) <- c("x", "y", "density")



## Coupe et plot

#### Avec toutes les régions

sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

plot_sahara <- st_make_valid(st_transform(ecoregions, 4326))

window_mask <- st_sfc(
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(-180, 15,
      10, 15,
      10, 35,
      -180, 35,
      -180, 15),
    ncol = 2,
    byrow = TRUE
  ))),
  crs = 4326
)

plot_sahara <- st_make_valid(st_transform(ecoregions, 4326))
window_mask <- st_make_valid(window_mask)

zone_crop <- st_intersection(plot_sahara, window_mask)




# Plot
ggplot() +

  # zone tronquée
  geom_sf(
    data = zone_crop,
    fill = NA,
    color = "azure2",
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # densité
  geom_raster(
    data = dens_sf,
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = density),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +

  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Densité") +

  # trajectoires
  geom_sf(
    data = lines_sf,
    aes(color = individual.local.identifier),
    alpha = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # SIT
  geom_sf(
    data = sit_sf,
    shape = 18,
    color = "cornflowerblue",
    size = 1.5
  ) +

  # nuit
  geom_sf(
    data = subset(pts_sf, daynight_0 == "night"),
    color = "black",
    size = 1,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +

  coord_sf() +

  theme_minimal()
```

# Régularité sur toute la migration

## Calcul de l'indice de régularité /!\\ A améliorer

Indice de régularité = **Distance moyenne entre les trajectoires d’un même individu, pour une saison donnée,**

On compare les trajectoires **au même moment.**

Aussi, il faut prendre en compte dans quel sens est cette distance, si on est décalé à droite, à gauche?

/!\\ Biais : La variabilité augmente surement plus on a de migration

Création de df_summary

```{r}
meta <- DATA_ALL %>%
  filter(!is.na(MIGRATION), !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  distinct(individual.local.identifier, MIGRATION, bird_year, age_group)

results <- list()

for(id in unique(meta$individual.local.identifier)) {
  for(seas in unique(meta$MIGRATION)) {
    idx <- which(meta$individual.local.identifier == id & meta$MIGRATION == seas)
    if(length(idx) > 1) {
      trajs <- traj_list_interp[idx]
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        individual = id,
        season = seas,
        variability = pairwise_dist(trajs),
        age = meta$age_group[idx[1]]
      )
    }
  }
}

df_summary <- do.call(rbind, results)

# véfification
head(df_summary)
table(df_summary$age, df_summary$season)
```

## Comparaison de la régularité

```{r}
# Visualisation de la régulatité sans tenir compte de la saison
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = age, y = variability, fill = age)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal()

# Représentation de la régularité par saison
ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = age, y = variability, fill = age)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ season) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("juvenile" = "darkorange1", "adult" = "darkorchid2"))
```

# Régularité par zone (grille spatiale) \# Problèmes mais meilleure idée

## Spring

```{r}
# Créer une grille spatiale
DATA_grid <- DATA_ALL_spring %>%
  mutate(
    x_bin = round(x, 1),   
    y_bin = round(y, 1)
  )
```

```{r}
# Créer une régularité locale
grid_summary <- DATA_grid %>%
  group_by(x_bin, y_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ind = n_distinct(individual.local.identifier),
    sd_x = sd(x),
    sd_y = sd(y),
    regularity = sqrt(sd_x^2 + sd_y^2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# => Si la régularité est faible, probablement zone critique
```

```{r}
# Représentation

ggplot() +

  # CARTE DE RÉGULARITÉ
  geom_tile(
    data = grid_summary,
    aes(x = x_bin, y = y_bin, fill = regularity)
  ) +

  # TRAJECTOIRES AU-DESSUS
  geom_path(
    data = DATA_ALL_spring,
    aes(x = x, y = y,
        group = interaction (individual.local.identifier,segment_id),
        color = age_group),
    alpha = 0.5,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  coord_equal() +

  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,   # zones fidèles en foncé
    name = "Régularité"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "juvenile" = "deeppink1",
    "adult" = "darkgoldenrod1"
  )) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```
